observations.author: Markuss Broks
observations.finding: BCM4361 PCIe patch v3 supplies IDs, firmware mapping, retention support and a 0x170000 RAM base. Port comment claiming the upstream patch used the 4359 RAM base does not describe this v3.

observations.author: Arend van Spriel
observations.finding: Requests adding 2G and 5G IDs to brcmf_pcie_devid_table, beyond their definitions.

Ten patch author headers identify Henrik Grimler. Root LICENSE is GPLv3, APKBUILD declares MIT, source notice is Linux Foundation BSD-style. No patch-specific grant independently established; preserve all evidence, do not infer blanket relicensing.
